name: CopyFile
description: Copies a file within Microsoft 365 SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and copy files in SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: Source File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint file URL to copy (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/File.txt).

fields.name: DrivePath
fields.label: Destination Folder Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint folder URL where the file should be copied (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/Folder).

fields.name: FileName
fields.label: New File Name
fields.description: The name for the copied file in the destination folder.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns metadata of the copied file, including ID, URL, and properties.
